It appers to be a bug. I'm able to reproduce it.

When you select an email, the background colour of the notification bar inverts from white to black. That's normal, however the text and icon colors should also invert from black to white. This isn't occuring so the bar becomes black icons and text on a black background.

In your example, only the "37" from your battery percentage has inverted to white.

In my tests the issue only occurs on the light theme. The dark theme displays correctly.

Can you create a new bug report on github linked below. https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-android/issues
